claim: JSON Schema 2020-12 is the current standard, split into Core and Validation vocabularies.
query: JSON Schema 2020-12 validation standard latest specification
snippet: The current version is 2020-12, which represents a significant update from the previous version. The specification is split into two parts, Core and Validation. Declare your schemas to have the dialect metaschema using the $schema keyword: { "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema" }
title: Draft 2020-12
topic: JSON Schema 2020-12 as the governing standard for validation

claim: Ajv is a high-performance JSON Schema validator supporting 2020-12 by compiling schemas into optimized JavaScript functions.
query: JSON Schema validation tools Ajv validator implementation
snippet: Ajv is the fastest JSON schema Validator. It supports JSON Schema draft-04/06/07/2019-09/2020-12 and JSON Type Definition (RFC8927). Ajv takes a schema and converts it into a very efficient JavaScript code that validates your data according to the schema.
title: Ajv JSON schema validator
topic: Ajv as a high-performance JSON Schema 2020-12 validator

claim: Best practices include organizing schemas in a central directory, validating schemas against the meta-schema in CI, and caching compiled validators.
query: JSON Schema document validation best practices 2026
snippet: Keep all schemas in a schemas/ directory at the repo root, and add a CI step that validates the schemas themselves against the JSON Schema meta-schema. Caching the compiled validation function is recommended for repeated validation against the same schema, significantly reducing processing time.
title: JSON Schema validation in 2026: Ajv, Python, browser guide | Go Tools
topic: Best practices for JSON Schema validation in production

claim: The official JSON Schema Test Suite contains over 6,000 tests across versions to verify conformance of validator implementations.
query: JSON Schema validator conformance test suite suite 2020-12
snippet: The JSON Schema Test Suite is a language agnostic test suite for validator implementations, with several hundred tests for each version totaling over 6,000 tests. For Draft 2020-12, implementations that achieve a perfect score confirm the correctness of their implementation.
title: JSON Schema Test Suite
topic: JSON Schema Test Suite for conformance validation

claim: JSON Schema validators report all errors in a single pass using JSON Pointer notation for precise error location.
query: schema validation error reporting JSON Schema output
snippet: Validation output includes evaluation path, schema location, instance location, and specific errors with descriptions. Error reports list failures using RFC 6901 JSON Pointer notation in the path field, allowing you to drill straight to the offending node in nested data. All errors are reported in a single pass instead of stopping at the first failure.
title: Interpreting JSON Schema Output
topic: JSON Schema validation error reporting structure

claim: JSON Schema 2020-12 is supported by validators across all major programming languages (JavaScript, Python, Rust, Java).
query: JSON Schema document validation best practices 2026
snippet: Every modern validator (Ajv, Python jsonschema, jsonschema-rs, Java's networknt/json-schema-validator) supports 2020-12 today. This means implementations in all major languages can validate against the same dialect.
